points: Your site lists a first order discount, yet 0 of 21 ads mention it, so a new buyer has no reason to act. Put it in the first line of three new ads and on the creative itself.

0 of 21 copy ads carry a proof number, so a buyer scrolling past has no reason to stop. Collect one figure you can verify, such as your review count or orders shipped, and open your next batch with it.

Your 21 copy ads open with 19 different stories, so no line is repeated enough to become your voice. Build your next batch from the two that repeat, the romantic gothic opener and home is where the haunt is.

26 ads have run 60 days or more, so the core work holds up. Build three variations of your oldest winner, the Hell’s Blankets video, changing only the opening line and adding the $129 free shipping line.
